egim_yontemi_en: 3x3 Horn on a 20 m grid (40 m baseline); east-west spacing corrected per row; byte rounded up
kaynak_en: 64 USGS Astrogeology CTX DTMs (MRO CTX, 20 m posting). Each DTM shifted vertically by the median MOLA difference in its own USGS qa_metrics.txt and horizontally by the offset of its own orthoimage against the Murray Lab CTX mosaic (itself aligned to the USGS Mars 2020 CTX orthomosaic); blended with ASP dem_mosaic. Single-cell spikes >30 m replaced by 5x5 median.
guven_notu_en: Effective resolution about 75-80 m (measured against the USGS 1 m HiRISE DTM): smaller hills, pits and craters are smoothed and their slopes underestimated. Absolute height can be off by up to about 20 m; slope uncertainty about 2 deg.
